description: Gesamtuebersicht aller kanonischen R4OS-Modulprojekte im neuen Multi-Repository-Workspace.
source_of_truth: Fuer Build, Version, Zielpfad und Abhaengigkeiten bleibt das jeweilige module.R4MF verbindlich.

scope.included: Kanonische Apps, Services, Diagnosen, Treiber, Protokolle, Subsysteme und Runtime-Libraries.
excluded: Verschachtelte Test- und Smoke-Fixtures innerhalb eines Modulprojekts.
Generierte oder gecachte Paketkopien, insbesondere unter zig-pkg.
Kernel, Contract, Distribution und Werkzeuge, sofern sie kein kanonisches R4X-, R4D-, R4P- oder R4L-Modulprojekt besitzen.
Die eingebauten Platform APIs R4SYS, R4DESK, R4DRAW, R4NET, R4AUDIO und R4DEV; sie sind Kernel-Provider und keine Module.

Recovery/Kernel 0.1.58 mit RECOVERY.R4X 0.1.21 akzeptiert die bisherigen kanonischen Release-Menues sowie die exakte Software-Grafik-Erweiterung aus R4OS 0.79.X. Vor dem SYSTEM-Update auf 0.79.8 zuerst Recovery aktualisieren und neu starten. Das Paket verlangt 2048 MB OS-nutzbaren RAM; jeder Auftrag reserviert seinen weiteren Arbeitsbedarf vor Zielschreibzugriffen. Selbstupdate aus der echten 0.1.57-Runtime und produktiver Ergebnisstart mit 3072 MB SMP4 geprueft; SYSTEM-Update auf 0.79.8 und Ergebnisstart mit 8192 MB SMP4 geprueft. Aktuelle Releases, Hashes und Abnahmegrenzen stehen in Docs/Deployment/Recovery.txt.

entries.name: R4GB
entries.notes: SUBSYSTEM_ID=r4os.gb; GUEST_FORMAT=gameboy.dmg-cartridge; module 0.10.12. Original userland DMG implementation with explicit CPU revision profiles and no proprietary boot ROM. Complete owned-ROM validation, full-ROM SHA-256 identity, bounded 64-KiB bus and ROM-only/MBC1/MBC1M/MBC2/MBC3/MBC30/MBC5/MMM01/digital-HuC1 models provide the cartridge foundation; hardware-bound mapper and accessory families are rejected precisely. Battery cartridges persist exact raw SRAM and versioned checksummed MBC3 RTC state below C:\R4OS\SUBSYSTEMS\r4os.gb\SAVE using the compiled-in shared SDK persistence helper: one generation-bound writer lease and an asynchronous serial snapshot worker with coalescing, same-directory atomic replacement, bounded retries for transient stream not-found/I/O faults across stage and private transaction-lease Begin/Write/Finish, ownership-aware Abort/Release retries, checked normal transaction release, bounded replay of retained stages after interrupted or lost-acknowledgement writes, exact-size and RTC-content validation before replay, last-good backup preservation until the canonical target is independently resolvable and validated, and mandatory drain-on-close; partial or malformed stages and orphaned backups fail closed, the former pre-release APPDATA path is never probed at runtime, and the one affected laptop installation was restored byte-identically before activation; non-battery cartridges never persist. The source migration retains R4GB's cartridge and 80-byte RTC policy and introduces neither an R4L nor a platform ABI. The complete SM83 core covers all 244 legal base and 256 CB paths through explicit read/write/idle M-cycles. One bounded 4.194304-MHz Machine clock owns DIV/TIMA reload behavior, IF/IE priority and dispatch retargeting, HALT/STOP wake, 160-byte OAM DMA with restart and DMG source decoding, the active-low P1 keyboard matrix, deterministic SB/SC transfer without link transport and the MBC3 RTC across CPU halt/stop. The dot-clocked DMG-C PPU models LCD modes, STAT/LY quirks, VRAM/OAM blocking and corruption, FIFO background/window timing, ten-sprite selection and DMG priorities, publishing complete changed 160x144 Indexed8 frames once through the shared-raster path of subsystem_host with bounded copy fallback. The four-channel DMG APU implements NR52/DIV sequencing, pulse sweep/envelopes including the hardware-defined disabled zero-pace state, wave RAM, noise LFSR, NR50/NR51 mixing and high-pass-filtered deterministic 48-kHz stereo S16LE through subsystem_runtime and App-Audio/AUDSVC; backend failure degrades only audio. The productive R4SUBSYS1 GUI host gives every launch a private Machine, one 32768-T-cycle-bounded slice per host cycle, generation-safe native video, ordered physical input, explicit pause/resume/reset/mute actions, App-Audio transport, concrete in-window failures and one idempotent teardown for runtime, window, save worker, ROM and machine resources. Installed MODULES.JSON metadata and ID-only ASSOC entries drive .gb/.gbc Explorer and Open With launches. Generated original cartridges prove two simultaneous 60-second instances on one- and four-vCPU QEMU, timed focus and lifecycle input, video, lossless App-Audio/APU accounting, asynchronous SRAM/RTC persistence, retained-stage replay, partial-stage rejection, separate close and visible CGB-only rejection without using commercial ROMs. A machine-readable qualification matrix records licenses, revisions, hashes, protocols, timeouts, targets and ten justified non-DMG/peripheral exclusions for six open source families. All 500000 pinned SM83 vectors, 28 production-machine mapper ROMs, 34 clock/I/O Mooneye ROMs, 32 PPU Mooneye ROMs, three DMG SameSuite ROMs, 25 pixel-exact Acid2/Mealybug images, all three RTC3Test groups and the Mealybug MBC3-RTC ROM pass: 15 suites, 852 files and 500129 result records. ST018 uses an original ARMv3/ARM60 core with seven modes and banked state, pipeline, all conditions, ALU/barrel shifts, short/long multiply, single/block transfers, swap, branch/link, PSR operations and exceptions; exact 128-KiB program ROM, 32-KiB data ROM, 16-KiB work RAM, host bridge, timer and 65536-cycle ready delay are isolated per instance. Product ST018 execution requires exact digest-bound 163840-byte ST018.ROM at C:\R4OS\SUBSYSTEMS\r4os.snes\FIRMWARE and never downloads, embeds or HLEs it. A generated open fixture binds productive bus/RAM state to DE7069060A5E262D and pinned Ares/Mesen2 sources; an optional private gate validates and boots the known image in place without emitting bytes. The same canonical save subtree and shared lease/serial snapshot worker also own ordinary SRAM, GSU RAM, SA-1 BW-RAM, ST010 RAM and checksummed RTC records. A ReleaseSafe maturity gate proves exact NTSC/PAL machine and streamed-PCM digests across 1-ms, 17-ms and irregular host pacing, 4096/32768-clock partitions, time regression, cold restart, different instance identity and repeated close. The final Lenovo-only commercial-ROM Teilabnahme confirmed start, image, audio, gameplay, every keyboard mapping and window/lifecycle behavior; approximately 5 FPS were explicitly accepted for 0.73.X, while writer-lease, reopen and cold-start observations were discarded rather than reported as PASS. 0.78.6 skips both persistence clocks for non-battery slices while retaining time and backend polls for active saves; the common audio runtime paces silence and keeps streams across transient producer gaps.
